name: Keep Claude PR review scoped to the authoritative PR diff after normal merges
description: Claude PR review can mis-scope a synchronized pull request after a normal merge from main: on PR #2664 at exact head a9d5f5e, GitHub's authoritative current diff contained 8 WI-2838 files, but the reviewer reported 31 files and requested changes solely for unrelated base-branch WI-2628 files. The strict-green gate must mechanically bind review findings to the authoritative PR diff while preserving trusted-base and latest-verdict protections.
acceptanceCriteria:
Root cause: review scope is prompt-only. The workflow asks Claude to run `gh pr diff`, but does not provide or mechanically enforce a GitHub-authoritative changed-file manifest; after a normal main merge the model can treat base-only checkout/history files as PR changes. The evaluator validates verdict author, head, freshness, and polarity, but not finding-path scope.

Variants: (a) clean PR diff; (b) synchronize after normal merge containing unrelated base files; (c) true finding in an authoritative changed path; (d) finding only in an out-of-diff path; (e) unchanged-head rerun; (f) absent/malformed verdict.

Done when:
1. Preserve incident evidence: PR #2664 head a9d5f5e had 8 authoritative changed files while Claude reported 31 and cited base-only paths.
2. A deterministic regression fixture covers synchronize after a normal merge.
3. Out-of-diff finding paths fail closed as review-scope corruption and cannot authorize a merge; valid changed-path findings retain current behavior.
4. An unchanged-head rerun can recover without commit churn.
5. Trusted-base execution, bot identity, prompt-injection defenses, least privilege, and WI-2512 latest-fresh-verdict semantics remain intact.
6. Structural/security tests pass, plus a live probe or repaired PR #2664 demonstrates correct scope.
riskImpact: P1: a fresh approved implementation can be falsely blocked by unrelated base-branch code after the mandated normal-merge policy. This corrupts a required strict-green authority gate and can stall every PR that refreshes from main.
